transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’m exhausted all the time, like I’m worn out before the day even starts, and I can’t seem to get my energy back. It has just been really hard to get through my daily routine lately because of how drained I feel.
Beyond feeling physically drained, have you noticed a persistent loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy, or do you feel a sense of sadness or hopelessness most of the time?

I wouldn't say I've lost interest or feel hopeless, because I still really want to paint, hike, and volunteer. It's just that I'm so physically exhausted and my mind is constantly overwhelmed with worries that I don't have the energy or focus to actually do them anymore.
Do you find that you have been struggling to control these worries about various aspects of your life, such as work, health, or daily responsibilities, on most days for the past six months?

Yes, I absolutely struggle to control them; once they start, they completely take over my mind and I can't shut them off. I constantly worry about making mistakes at the lab and getting fired, or my parents back in El Salvador getting sick. This has been happening almost every day for the last seven or eight months since I started my full-time lab job.
Besides the constant worry and exhaustion, have you been experiencing physical symptoms like muscle tension, restlessness, or difficulty falling or staying asleep?

Yes, absolutely. I feel wound up and jumpy all the time, like I've had way too much coffee, and my leg is constantly bouncing. My shoulders and neck also get incredibly tight by the end of the day, and I find myself clenching my jaw without even realizing it.
